site.name: Oak & Pixel
site.description: Oak & Pixel Studio is a web design agency in Randburg that designs, builds, hosts, and maintains refined websites for service-based businesses.

pages.title: Oak & Pixel - Web Design Agency in Randburg, South Africa

services.name: Signature Plan
services.summary: A professional custom website up to 5 pages, mobile responsive, with contact and lead forms, basic SEO, hosting and domain management, 2 monthly content updates, and email support. Pricing is R12,500 setup plus R1,800/month.

services.name: Growth Plan
services.summary: A larger website built to generate leads, with everything in Signature plus up to 10 pages, landing pages, online booking, blog or CMS, payment or CRM integration, a monthly SEO report, 5 monthly content updates, and priority support. Pricing is R25,000 setup plus R3,200/month.

services.name: Premium Plan
services.summary: A fully bespoke website with everything in Growth plus custom design, advanced animations, e-commerce or client portal functionality, advanced integrations, unlimited content updates, monthly optimisation reviews, and a dedicated account lead. Pricing is from R55,000 setup plus R6,500/month.

services.name: Website Scoping Call
services.summary: A free conversation to match the right website plan to your business, page requirements, integrations, and support needs.
